roadmap_summary: To understand the paper, the learner should first build foundations in linear algebra, probability, and neural networks before studying sequence models, attention, and finally transformers.

nodes.label: Vectors and Matrices
nodes.description: Foundational linear algebra concepts needed to understand embeddings and tensor operations.

nodes.label: Probability Basics
nodes.description: Useful for understanding softmax, likelihoods, and model outputs.

nodes.label: Neural Networks
nodes.description: Basic understanding of feedforward networks, backpropagation, and training.

nodes.label: Sequence Models
nodes.description: Understand sequence-to-sequence learning and recurrent modeling.

nodes.label: Attention Mechanism
nodes.description: Core concept required before studying transformers.

nodes.label: Transformers
nodes.description: Final target concept needed to understand the uploaded paper.

resource_suggestions.value: Look for beginner resources on vectors, matrices, and matrix multiplication.
Study encoder-decoder attention and self-attention before reading transformer architecture.
